prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all change types; at least 2 tests of a kind are required to establish a rule.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -4.8% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at +1.7% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at -0.5% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish redesign changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -6.3% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too high across all change types compared to noise-corrected measurements.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -4.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -6.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Prep Progress and Status Updates: Add visible progress bar and time estimate with periodic tips on the waiting screen while background processes render the pet. (why: The home step has a long mean duration of 2336s and median of 201s, leaving users uncertain if generation stalled.)
1: [choose_path, layout] Compact Path Selection Layout: Switch path selection screen to a compact centered layout with progress indicator. (why: Choose path stage has a high mean time of 514s, showing users hesitate when selecting an onboarding route.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Stalling Fallback Hint: Display a helpful fallback hint if the sign-in modal load takes longer than expected. (why: Support logs highlight 2 users encountering screen stalling or non-responsive sign-in screens.)
3: [finish, notification] Desktop Readiness Notification Alert: Enable system notification trigger on home intro to notify users when the pet is ready on desktop. (why: Finish step mean time is 5815s, indicating users minimize or leave the desktop app unattended while waiting.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Choice: Move sign-in step to occur after pet pick and photo upload steps, right before certificate finalization. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and overall onboarding is 17.8%; building pet commitment first reduces drop-off.)
5: [finish, new_screen] New System Tray & Desktop Guide Screen: Add a dedicated guide screen right before home intro explaining desktop placement and tray icon actions. (why: Support received multiple issues regarding desktop feature misbehavior (4 emails) and control confusion (3 emails).)

scores.note: Long mean duration on home wait step indicates user drop-off during rendering, but lack of support emails keeps evidence moderate.
Path selection shows high mean duration in funnel, though evidence relies solely on funnel data.
Both funnel drop-off (72.9%) and support logs (2 stalling complaints) point to sign-in friction; easy config/hint change.
Finish step mean time of 5815s shows users leave the app unattended; notifications can re-engage them.
Prior test for sign_in reorder yielded -0.5% lift, giving low confidence despite funnel motivation.
Strong evidence from funnel and multiple support emails (7 total), but requires a new screen (cost 0) where historical tests performed poorly.
